original_diagnostics.distribution_checks_note: Descriptive diagnostics only; they never switch the method. A large Shapiro-Wilk p-value does not prove normality, and a small one alone does not rule out the planned test. Shapiro runs only for 3 <= n <= 5000.

breusch_pagan.method: Koenker studentized Breusch-Pagan LM (n * auxiliary R-squared)
breusch_pagan.note: Squared OLS residuals regressed on an intercept and x; chi-square(1) asymptotic p-value. Small samples can exaggerate significance. A large p-value does not establish constant variance.
